newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Spring/White Wheat - Basis mostly lower.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Spring/White Wheat - Basis mostly lower.

text.p: Basis levels for dark northern spring wheat were mostly lower on Thursday in line with weaker MGE spring wheat futures, dealers said.
Grain merchandisers in Minnesota and North Dakota said bitter cold temperatures and blizzard-like conditions hampered the shipment of grain. Many elevators were shut down, they said.

The National Weather Service said winds of 45 to 50 miles per hour were causing blizzard conditions in eastern South Dakota, southwestern Minnesota and northwest Iowa. Wind chills were expected to drop to 50 to 70 degrees below zero (F) Thursday night.
White-out conditions were over many areas and some interstate highways were closed in the Northern Plains, a North Dakota merchandiser said.
MGE March spring wheat lost four cents a bushel to end at $3.90-1/4.
